summary: Router 0.42.12 closes TM-08's next action 'per-client cost bounds for cloud' (ADR-0135, proposed). New optional client_auth.clients.<c>.cloud_budget_month (int or float 0-100000, not bool; 0/absent = no limit); config refuses other values, settings.EDITABLE gets the same bounds for the web UI (Clients). Traced B6: proxy sets req.cloud_block = cloud.request_block_reason(req, body, request.get('client')) before tier selection; request.py reports it as the skip reason of every cloud tier (provider_block_reason only when it is None), so a reached budget closes all cloud tiers of the request and local tiers continue. The check runs after the client's cloud:false opt-out and before data-class and credential checks; it only adds a refusal reason, it never opens a tier. Spend source: cloud.client_spend_month sums days[YYYY-MM-*].clients[client].cost_chf in state.USAGE, which metrics.usage_add increments in observe_request for every finished request with its cost (proxy._finish -> metrics.observe_request with info['client']); usage_save keeps 90 days. The client name comes from the authenticated identity (request['client'] set by client_auth_middleware), so a client cannot spend under another's name; unidentified observe requests have no client budget (as before). Client view adds budget and spend (auth.client_auth_view, late import of cloud to avoid a cycle). Overshoot: requests already in flight finish and are charged, like the provider budget. No exception path added.

tests.evidence: 4 tests: spend sums only this month's cost of this client (another month and another client excluded); below the budget cloud stays open, at the budget request_block_reason names the exhausted budget (rejected case), no budget / 0 / unidentified unchanged; client view shows budget and spend; configuration refuses -1, 100001, '5', True, [5]. With cloud.py, config.py and auth.py from origin/main 6 failures and 2 errors.

limitations: Requests in flight when the budget is reached still finish and are charged (overshoot by what is in flight).
The spend is what usage.json holds; deleting it resets the month (and the usage view).
The web UI shows the budget field in the client settings; the spend is in /admin/state, not yet drawn in the client card.
